blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion process.We propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.
blocks.zh: 视频传播模型能够生成具有高质量外观和纹理品质的样本. 然而,据了解,这些方法产生的内容存在重大的物理错误。 这是因为,在一个古典的视频生成环境中,所有物理推理必须同时进行,并且完全在传播过程中进行. 我们建议通过将物理推理的任务重新分配给一个语言模型支持的键框生成模块来解决这些问题,这个模块允许在语言中明确推理,并在视频的重要时刻精细地控制视频的出现. 然后我们用这些键框来设定一个视频生成模型, 将扩散模型的作用降低到更简单的任务, 在物理正确中间状态之间插插, 而不是用扩散来推断整个序列。 结果表明,我们的做法大大超过现有做法,在物理-IQ验证基准和PhyGen Bench上取得了最新业绩。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
Video generation models are increasingly positioned as ‘world simulators’ ( OpenAI, 2024 ) : models which, given a starting observation or a text prompt alone, can evolve a scene forward in time to give plausible future states.
The framing originates with Sora ( OpenAI, 2024 ) , which points to properties such as 3D consistency and object permanence as evidence that a generator trained only on pixels acquires a model of the world it depicts.
Other works build on this premise. Genie ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) uses a video model directly as an interactive environment which a user acts in, and the model renders the consequences. Cosmos 3 ( NVIDIA et al., 2026 ) positions its ‘omnimodal world model’ as a potential backbone for autonomous physical agents.
However, video diffusion models are known to perform poorly when tasked with generating physically plausible videos.
Physics-IQ ( Motamed et al., 2026 ) defines a world model as a video model which has internalised physical principles, and shows that existing models are severely limited in the satisfaction of this definition despite the high visual fidelity of their outputs.
The same conclusion is reached by VideoPhy-2 ( Bansal et al., 2025 ) , PhyGenBench ( Meng et al., 2025 ) and PhyWorldBench ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , which together demonstrate failures across a broad spectrum of physical phenomena.
blocks.zh:
视频生成模型越来越被定位为"世界模拟器"(OpenAI, 2024 ) : 仅凭一个开始观察或文字提示, 就可以及时演化出一个场景,
框架起源于Sora (OpenAI, 2024),其中指出3D一致性等属性和对象常态,作为仅受像素训练的生成器获得所描绘世界模型的证据.
其他的作品都以这个前提为基础. Genie(Bruce等,2024年)直接使用视频模型作为交互环境,用户在其中行事,而该模型则造成后果. Cosmos 3(NVIDIA等,2026年)将其 " 通用世界模式 " 定位为自主物理剂的潜在骨干。
然而,据了解,视频传播模式在负责制作实际可行的视频时表现不佳。
Physics-IQ(Motamed等,2026年)将世界模型定义为具有内在物理原理的视频模型,并显示尽管其输出的视觉忠实度很高,但现有模型在满足这一定义方面受到严重限制.
VideoPhy-2(Bansal等,2025年),PhyGen Bench(Meng等,2025年)和PhyWorld Bench(Gu等,2026年)也得出了同样的结论,它们共同证明了各种广泛的物理现象的失败.

blocks.en:
In this paper we introduce Keyframes to Video (K2V), a novel approach to video generation which simplifies the task required of a video model to interpolation between keyframes, offloading physical inference to a separate keyframe generation module.
Our first insight is that video models are more successful at reconstructing the physical motion connecting two explicit keyframes than at inferring plausible physical motion from a starting state entirely in diffusion space.
We identify a simple training-free approach to condition an existing video generation model, Wan2.2 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , to perform the task of keyframe interpolation.
Our second insight is that the physical reasoning required to plan those keyframes is already present in language models.
We therefore introduce a novel keyframe generation module, in which a language model plans the physical evolution of the scene.
This approach redistributes the load of physical planning away from a video diffusion model and onto a language model, which can then finely control an image edit model to produce the intended physical effect.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了Keyframes to Video(K2V),这是一种新型的视频生成方法,它简化了在键帧之间插入的视频模型所需的任务,将物理推论卸入了单独的键帧生成模块.
我们的第一点见解是,视频模型在重建连接两个显式键框的物理运动方面比从完全在扩散空间的起始状态推断出合理的物理运动更为成功.
我们确定了一种简单的无培训方法,以规范现有的视频生成模式 -- -- Wan2.2(Wan等,2025年),以履行关键框架插入的任务。
我们的第二个见解是,规划这些关键框架所需的物理推理已经存在于语言模型中。
因此我们引入了一个新的键框生成模块,其中语言模型规划了场景的物理演化.
这种方法将物理规划的负荷从视频传播模型中重新分配到语言模型上,然后可以精细地控制图像编辑模型来产生预期的物理效果.

blocks.en:
We argue that this division between planning keyframes and interpolating between them is the right allocation of effort for physically plausible generation, since the keyframe module can concentrate compute, both in tokens and in keyframe density, on the scenes and tasks which are most complex.
A per-scene analysis of our results on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark confirms that our approach does scale its effort with scene complexity in this way.
blocks.zh:
我们主张,规划关键框架和相互插入之间的这种区分是对实际可行的生成的正确努力分配,因为关键框架模块可以把计算集中在最复杂的场景和任务上,无论是象征性的还是关键框架密度的。
对物理-IQ核查基准结果的逐一分析证实,我们的方法确实以这种方式以场景复杂性来扩大其努力。

blocks.en:
K2V contributes to an existing line of research which enables physically plausible generation by delegating the physics to a separate model.
Existing works, such as PhysGen ( Liu et al., 2024 ) and VDAWorld ( O’Mahony et al., 2026 ) , leverage explicit physics simulators to propagate the physical properties of scenes forward in time, before rendering these scenes or using the output of these simulations to condition a video model.
NEWTON ( Feng et al., 2026 ) instead equips an agent with a sandboxed interpreter in which the relevant physical quantities are computed explicitly.
However, reliance on simulators carries significant limitations.
Using simulators restricts the operating domain of these methods to settings where simulators are accurate and available, and the methods must first create a mapping from image to code, which can introduce errors.
We dispense with simulators entirely, relying on the physical reasoning of language models in their place.
In contrast to these works, we also reformulate the task posed to the video generator into one of interpolation, rigidly imposing the conditions created by the keyframe module.
blocks.zh:
K2V有助于现有的研究,通过将物理委托给一个单独的模型,使物理上可行的生成成为可能。
现存的作品有"PhysGen"(刘等,2024年)和"VDAWorld"(O'Mahony等,2026年)等,利用明确的物理模拟器来及时传播场景的物理性质,在渲染出这些场景之前或使用这些模拟的输出来给视频模型设条件.
NEWTON(Feng等,2026年)为代理人配备了沙箱解释器,其中明确计算出相关物理量。
然而,对模拟器的依赖具有重大的局限性。
使用模拟器将这些方法的操作域限制在模拟器准确而可用的设置上,这些方法必须首先创建从图像到代码的映射,这可以引入错误.
我们完全不用模拟器, 依靠语言模型的物理推理来代替它们。
与这些作品不同,我们还把给视频生成器的任务重新编为插图任务,僵硬地强加了键框模块所创造的条件.

blocks.en:
Through comprehensive experiments we show that K2V is highly effective at producing physically plausible generations, reaching state-of-the-art performance by a significant margin on Physics-IQ Verified ( Rädsch et al., 2026 ) , a benchmark designed specifically to evaluate physical plausibility.
Keyframing raises Wan2.2-14B from 32.2 to 55.0 on the Physics-IQ Verified image-to-video track.
The gain also extends to the efficiency of generation: the much lighter Wan2.2-5B reaches 50.0 when supported by our method, substantially outperforming the unmodified 14B backbone at roughly a third of the parameters.
We also report state-of-the-art results on PhyGenBench ( Meng et al., 2025 ) , raising the state of the art from 0.56 to 0.63.
The two benchmarks test complementary abilities.
Physics-IQ Verified is image-to-video and scores how a scene evolves from a given observation, so it chiefly measures the motion between frames.
PhyGenBench is text-to-video and scores whether the frames themselves carry the correct physical appearance of a phenomenon, such as the flame colour of a burning metal, so it chiefly measures accuracy within a frame.
blocks.zh:
我们通过全面实验表明,K2V在产生物理上可信的几代人方面非常有效,在物理-IQ验证(Rädsch等,2026年)上达到最先进的性能,这是专门用来评价物理上的合理性的基准。
Keyframing在物理-IQ验证成像到视频轨道上将Wan2.2-14B从32.2提高到55.0.
收益还延伸到发电效率:Wan2.2-5B轻得多,在我们的方法支持下达到50.0,在大约三分之一的参数上大大超过未经修改的14B主干线。
我们还报告了关于PhyGen Bench(Meng等,2025年)的最新结果,将最先进的水平从0.56提高到了0.63.
这两个基准检验了互补能力。
物理学-智商 校验是图像到视频,并得分一个场景如何从给定的观察演化,因此它主要测量帧之间的运动.
PhyGen Bench是文本到视频的,对帧本身是否带有一个现象的正确物理外观进行分数,如燃烧金属的火焰颜色,因此它主要在帧内测量精度.

blocks.en:
K2V carries two further advantages over end-to-end pixel generation.
Firstly, a user can inspect and correct the keyframes of a scene before a full video is generated, and so revise an output without incurring the cost of producing a complete sample, which can be very high for modern state-of-the-art video generators.
Secondly, in contrast to pure diffusion, K2V incorporates explicit reasoning into video generation.
The thinking tokens produced by the language model in our keyframe generation module illustrate a consideration of how various objects would interact and move over the course of a video, and lead to correct results in scenes which require reasoning about complex effects such as air pressure or chemical combustion.
blocks.zh:
K2V携带了与端到端像素生成相比的另外两个优势.
首先,用户可以在产生完整的视频之前检查和纠正场景的键框,因此在不承担制作完整的样本成本的情况下修改出一个输出,这对于现代最先进的视频发电机来说可能非常高.
第二,与纯传播相反,K2V将明确的推理纳入到视频生成中.
在我们的关键框架生成模块中,语言模型产生的思维符号说明了对各种物体如何在视频过程中相互作用和移动的考虑,并导致在镜头中得出正确结果,这些场景需要推理出诸如气压或化学燃烧等复杂效应.

blocks.en: In summary, we make the following contributions: • K2V, a training-free approach to physically plausible video generation which reduces the task posed to a video model to interpolation between keyframes, and which delegates physical planning to a separate module. • A keyframe module in which a vision-language model directs an image edit model, producing a stack of keyframes with timestamps and an expanded caption. Physical reasoning is performed in language, and no physics simulator is used at any stage. • A training-free mechanism for conditioning Wan2.2 on keyframes pinned at arbitrary interior latent frames, which the model’s stock conditioning interface cannot express. • State-of-the-art results on Physics-IQ Verified and PhyGenBench, together with an analysis showing that planning effort is spent in proportion to the physical complexity of a scene.

blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Boundary- and Keyframe-Conditioned Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1. 边界和关键框架视频生成

blocks.en:
Conditioning a video model on frames other than the first is an established setting.
Wan2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) was later released with a first-last-frame variant, which imposes boundary
conditions at the two ends of the clip, requiring that the model interpolate between these two frames,
and VACE ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , built on the same backbone, is trained to accept reference frames at other
positions, including randomly chosen ones.
LTX-Video ( HaCohen et al., 2024 ) goes further still, accepting conditioning images at arbitrary frame
positions in its standard inference pipeline. Wang et al. (2025) adapt an image-to-video model to keyframe interpolation by fine-tuning
a backwards-in-time variant and combining it with the forward direction.
Meanwhile, Zhu et al. (2025) drive the same task with explicit frame-wise conditions. Zhang et al. (2026) go further, distilling a model that generates in arbitrary
temporal order rather than from a fixed anchor.

blocks.en: 2.2. Serial and Parallel Computation
blocks.zh: 2.2. 顺序计算和平行计算

blocks.en:
Liu et al. (2026) draw a distinction between problems which admit parallel solution and
those which are inherently serial, requiring a chain of dependent steps that cannot be collapsed into
simultaneous work. They show that diffusion models remain within TC 0 \mathrm{TC}^{0} however many
denoising steps are taken, so a bidirectional video diffusion model supplies no more serial depth than
its network has layers, irrespective of the length of the clip it generates. Physical evolution is
serial in precisely this sense, since where a scene arrives depends on the states it passed through,
which suggests a reason for the failures measured by the benchmarks above that is independent of data
and parameter count.

all at once. Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) gives each token an independent noise
level, so a causal model can roll a sequence forward beyond its training horizon.

architecture, running autoregressive diffusion at high noise, where the serial computation coordinates
interdependent events, before reverting to parallel diffusion at low noise.

blocks.en: 2.3. Agentic and Language-Model-Planned Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3. 代理和语言模式规划一代

blocks.en:
A recent line of work combines language models with video generators, and uses the language model to supply the physics which the caption omits. Wang et al. (2026b) use a language model to reason
about a chain of causally connected physical events, and subsequently condition a generator on that
chain. Cudlenco et al. (2026) constrain an agent’s plan against the capabilities of
a 3D engine and executes it deterministically, thus obtaining physical validity by construction. Li et al. (2026) treat each physical program as an executable hypothesis, closing a loop of simulation, verification and targeted program repair.

blocks.en: 2.4. Simulator-Grounded Video Generation

blocks.en:
An alternative is to obtain dynamics from an explicit simulator rather than from a
generative prior. PhysGen ( Liu et al., 2024 ) recovers geometry and material properties from a
single image, simulate rigid-body dynamics in image space, and use a diffusion model to
render and refine the result.
VDAWorld ( O’Mahony et al., 2026 ) takes the abstraction furthest, having a vision-language
model assemble a grounded 2D or 3D scene representation from an image-caption pair,
select a simulator appropriate to the scene, and infer latent dynamics to roll the
state forward. However, it is not a pixel generator: its output is a simulated abstract scene
rather than photorealistic video.

blocks.en:
These approaches abstract the scene into a representation a simulator can integrate, leading to
a queryable state and physical guarantees. However, this approach degrades wherever
the abstraction is unable to reproduce accurate dynamics; for example deformation, fluids, fracture and contact-rich interaction.
We maintain pixels throughout, construct no scene model, and ask
a language model for the states the scene passes through rather than for equations
defining them. A recent survey situates both lines of work within a common taxonomy of physical cognition in video generation ( Lin et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en:
Our approach leverages a generative keyframing module to produce keyframes along with timestamps, marking out distinct physical phases which occur in the generated video.
This keyframe set is used as conditioning for a video generation model.
In addition, the keyframe generation module returns an expanded caption, which describes precisely how the scene evolves, further reducing the physical inference which the diffusion model must perform itself.
An overview of our method is shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh:
我们的方法利用一个基因键盘花纹模块来制作键框和时间戳,标出在生成的视频中发生的不同物理相。
此键框集被作为视频生成模型的调制.
此外,键帧生成模块还返回了扩展后的标题,准确描述场景的演化过程,进一步减少了扩散模型必须进行自身的物理推断.
图2概述了我们的方法。

blocks.en: 3.1. Keyframe Module
blocks.zh: 3.1. 关键框架模块

blocks.en:
The keyframe module is an agentic pipeline.
A central planning agent, Gemini 3.8 Flash ( DeepMind, 2026b ) , orchestrates the keyframe generation.
The planning agent is given the original caption for the video, a task-agnostic prompt, and, optionally, the image intended for the video generation model.
Where no image is supplied, as in the text-conditioned setting, the agent generates the first keyframe from the caption alone, and generation proceeds identically thereafter.
The prompt informs the agent that it has a set of tools which it should use to generate a stack of keyframes which represent the motion in the next five seconds of video.
The general pipeline by which the planning agent generates the keyframes is fixed, although it is given flexibility through its use of tooling.
A diagram of the keyframe module is shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh:
键框模块是干线管.
中央计划代理人双子座 3.8 Flash(DeepMind,2026b.),管弦键帧生成.
规划代理被赋予视频的原始标题,任务不可知的快取,以及可选的用于视频生成模型的图像.
在不提供图像的情况下,如在文字条件设置中,代理人仅从标题中生成第一个键框,然后生成过程相同。
提示通知代理商,它有一套工具,应该用来生成一叠键框,在接下来的5秒视频中代表运动.
规划代理人生成键框的一般管道是固定的,尽管通过使用工具使其具有灵活性。
关键框架模块的图表见图3。

blocks.en:
First, the planning agent is directed to imagine how the scene will evolve in the next five seconds, and consider how these could be divided by keyframes into distinct phases of motion.
The agent generates each keyframe in sequence, enforcing the causal nature of physically-plausible generation.
blocks.zh:
首先,规划代理人被引导去想象场景将如何在未来5秒内演化,并考虑这些场景如何被键框分割成不同的运动阶段.
剂会按顺序生成每个键框,执行物理-相机生成的因果关系.

blocks.en:
For each keyframe, the agent writes an editing instruction describing how the scene should change to reach the next keyframe.
This instruction is passed to an image edit model, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image ( DeepMind, 2026a ) , along with the most recently-generated keyframe.
If no keyframes have been generated yet, the input image is passed to the image edit model.
Once the keyframe is generated, it is added to the stack of keyframes along with a timestamp for the keyframe provided by the planning agent.
blocks.zh:
对于每个密钥框架,代理写一个编辑指令,描述场景应如何改变以达到下一个密钥框架.
此指令被传递给图像编辑模型双子座 3.1 Flash Image(DeepMind, 2026a),以及最近产生的密钥框架.
如果尚未生成密钥框架,则输入图像被传递到图像编辑模型.
键框一经生成,就被添加到密钥框的堆叠上,并加上规划代理人提供的密钥框的时间戳.

blocks.en: 3.1.1. Agentic Tooling
blocks.zh: 3.1.1. 代理工具

blocks.en:
Tooling gives flexibility to this generation loop.
At each stage, the agent is free to select which tool it uses, so the pace of the progression through the keyframe generation pipeline is controlled by the agent, and many loops may be undertaken until the keyframes are asserted to be complete.
The tools let the agent render an edit, view and evaluate the result, commit it to the keyframe stack with a timestamp, and close the loop with an expanded caption.
Their full specifications are given in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
工具化为这个世代循环提供了灵活性.
在每一个阶段,代理都可以自由选择它使用的哪个工具,因此通过键帧生成管道的进取速度由代理控制,在密钥帧被断言完整之前,可能进行许多回转.
这些工具让代理制作一个编辑,查看和评价结果,用时间戳将其输入密钥框堆栈,并用扩展后的标题来关闭循环.

blocks.en: Figure 3. Keyframe module detail. A VLM planning agent orchestrates a recursive loop producing keyframes. blocks.en: 3.1.2. Repeat Keyframes
blocks.zh: 3.1.2. 重复键框

blocks.en:
It is often advantageous for the model to repeat a keyframe where no motion occurs in a given time interval, which it can do trivially by calling add_keyframe(time) twice with no render_edit(instruction) between them.
However, often, when two identical keyframes are placed far apart in time, for example at 0.0 ​ s 0.0s and at 5.0 ​ s 5.0s , the video model invents spurious motion between these timestamps.
For this reason, where repeat keyframes are used, we also automatically insert additional keyframes every second between the two identical keyframes.
We additionally hold the video still once the plan says the scene has come to rest.
Where the plan ends in repeated keyframes, or where its final two keyframes are near-identical (a mean absolute difference below 4 grey levels), we repeat the frame at the start of that interval for the remainder of the video.
We ablate this treatment of repeated keyframes in Section 4.5 .

然而,当两个相同的键框被放得相去甚远时,例如:0.0s 0.0s和5.0s 5.0s时,视频模型往往在这些时间戳之间发明出虚假的运动.

我们放弃了4.5节对重复键框的处理。

blocks.en: 3.3. Image and Video Post-Processing
blocks.zh: 3.3. 图像和录像处理后处理

blocks.en:
While the method works remarkably well out of the box, we notice improvements to our results with the use of image and video post-processing.
We attribute this to the fact that the image edit model, while very successful at maintaining physical consistency, occasionally introduces subtle color variations relative to the edit image.
For this reason, before passing the keyframes to the video model, the images are colour matched using a simple affine transformation to the input image.
Once the video is generated, we also match each frame to the first frame in the same manner.
This mitigates any artefacts induced by the subtle colour variations resulting from the image edit model.
blocks.zh:
虽然这一方法非常有效,但我们注意到,通过使用图像和视频后处理,我们的成果有了改进。
我们将此归因于图像编辑模型虽然在保持物理一致性上非常成功,但偶尔会引入相对于编辑图像的微妙的颜色变化.
为此,在将键框传递到视频模型之前,图像会使用简单的同源变换来输入图像来配色.
一旦视频生成,我们也以同样的方式将每个相框与第一个相框相匹配.
这减轻了由图像编辑模型产生的微妙色彩变化所引发的任何手工艺品。

blocks.en: 4. Results
blocks.zh: 4.四. 结果

blocks.en:
We select our experiments to show the broad applicability of our approach in first frame and text conditioned settings.
Our results highlight that, both qualitatively and quantitatively, our approach outperforms existing methods and produces videos which correctly follow physical laws.
blocks.zh:
我们选择我们的实验来显示我们的方法在第一个框架和文本条件设置中的广泛适用性.
我们的成果突出表明,无论在质量上还是在数量上,我们的方法都超过了现有方法,制作了正确遵循物理定律的视频。

blocks.en: 4.1. First Frame-Conditioned Generation
blocks.zh: 4.1. 第一帧条件生成

blocks.en:
To examine our approach on first frame-conditioned video generation, we use the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark.
This benchmark is designed to evaluate video models’ ability to adhere to physical laws across a range of categories.
Categories include solid mechanics, optics, thermodynamics, magnetism and fluid mechanics.
In each example, two ground truth videos are provided within Physics-IQ Verified from a single identical setting, and generative models are scored on whether the variation between their generation and one of the ground truth videos is greater than the variance between the two ground truth samples.
Thus, all results are scored as an error beyond physical variance.
We evaluate our method on the image to video setting, wherein the first frame of a video and a caption describing the setting is passed to the video generator.
blocks.zh:
为了审查我们对于第一个帧条件的视频生成的方法,我们采用了物理-IQ验证基准.
这一基准旨在评价视频模型在一系列类别中遵守实体法的能力。
类别包括固体力学,光学,热力学,磁学和流体力学等.
在每个例子中,在物理-IQ验证中从一个单一相同的设定中提供两个地真视频,并且对基因模型进行分数,以确定其生成与一个地真视频之间的差异是否大于两个地真样本之间的差异.
因此,所有结果都被评为超出物理差异的错误.
我们评价我们拍摄录像的方法, 其中第一个描述录像和字幕的框架 传递给录像生成器。

blocks.en:
We show a selection of results in Figure 5 .
Our approach produces videos which strictly adhere to physical laws such as gravity, collisions, and which preserve the number and size of objects throughout the video.
blocks.zh:
我们在图5中显示了一些结果。
我们的方法制作的视频严格遵守了物理定律,如重力,相撞,并在整个视频中保留了物体的数量和大小.

blocks.en: Figure 5. Qualitative results from our approach. The top row shows an example from Physics-IQ Verified and the bottom row an example from PhyGenBench. These results highlight the diverse placement of keyframes in different videos, and the physical quality of the resulting generated videos.
blocks.zh: 图 5. 我们的做法产生了定性结果。 上行显示一个来自Physics-IQ验证的示例,下行显示一个来自PhyGen Bench的示例. 这些结果凸显出不同视频中键框的不同位置,以及由此产生的视频的物理质量。

blocks.en:
Quantitatively, our approach outperforms all baselines by a significant margin.
Compared to a vanilla implementation of Wan2.2-14B, our approach leads to an improvement of 22.8 points.
Compared to the prior state of the art, our approach leads to an improvement of 12.3 points.
We attribute the significant improvement in this metric to the ability of our method to reason about and plan the physical evolution of a scene, and to its ability to impose that plan on the video generation phase.
blocks.zh:
从数量上看,我们的做法比所有基线都好得多。
相较于香草实施Wan2.2-14B,我们的方法导致22.8分的改进.
相较于之前的先进水平,我们的方法导致12.3分的改进.
我们把这一衡量标准的重大改进归因于我们解释和规划一个场景的物理演进的方法的能力,以及将该计划强加于视频生成阶段的能力。

As well as scoring more highly, we also highlight the advantage of our method that, as opposed to pure video diffusion, the error made by our method does not appear to drift over the course of the video.
We show this in the upper-left panel of Figure 7 .
Whereas generations from Wan2.2-14B degrade over the course of a video, straying further and further from the ground truth, our approach does not.
Instead, its mean squared error beyond physical variance remains fairly consistent over the examined 5 seconds.
blocks.zh:
除了评分更高外,我们还强调了我们方法的优点,即与纯粹的视频传播相比,我们方法造成的错误似乎不会在视频过程中漂移.
我们在图7左上方的面板上显示这一点。
虽然Wan2.2-14B的几代人在录像过程中退化,越来越偏离了事实真相,但我们的做法并非如此。
相反,在所检查的5秒钟中,其超出物理相差的平方差平均值仍然相当一致。

blocks.en:
We additionally highlight that, because our method effectively implements reasoning via its use of a language model, the approach efficiently spends compute on those scenes and moments which are particularly challenging.
All videos are required by the prompt to use keyframes at 0s (the input image) and at 5s; but beyond these constraints the model is free to add keyframes where it thinks they are required.
The keyframe density plot shown in the lower-left panel of Figure 7 highlights that the model does use keyframes at a range of moments within videos.
blocks.zh:
我们还强调,由于我们的方法通过使用一种语言模式来有效地进行推理,因此这种方法在那些特别具有挑战性的场景和时刻中有效地使用了计算。
所有录相带都需由即时在0s(输入图像)和5s使用密钥框;但除这些限制外,模型还可以在其认为需要的地方自由添加密钥框.
图7左下方的面板所显示的键框密度图强调,模型确实在视频中的一系列瞬间使用键框.

blocks.en:
The right panel of Figure 7 shows that the language model also spends more time on scenes which are particularly complex.
A trivial scene of a duck remaining motionless is reasoned about for less than 10 seconds, whereas a complex scene showing a row of dominos with a gap in the middle takes more than 5 minutes, since the model must reason about whether the domino chain will cross the gap.
The reasoning trace extracted from the language model for this clip reveals the model considering this problem: “I can see that the gap between domino 4 and domino 5 is wide enough for the domino 5 to fall without hitting domino 4 and for it to be a valid demonstration”.
blocks.zh:
图7的右面板显示,语言模型也花费更多时间拍摄特别复杂的场景.
一个细小的鸭子残存的无运动场景的推理时间不到10秒,而显示中间有间隙的一排多米诺斯的复杂场景则需要超过5分钟,因为模型必须说明多米诺链是否会跨越间隙.
从该片段的语言模型中提取的推理线索揭示了模型考虑这一问题:“我可以看到,多米诺4和多米诺5之间的差距已经足够大了,可以让多米诺5跌倒而不击中多米诺4,并成为有效的演示”。

blocks.en: 4.2. Text-Conditioned Generation
blocks.zh: 4.2. 有文字条件的生成

blocks.en:
We evaluate text-conditioned generation on the PhyGenBench ( Meng et al., 2025 ) benchmark.
In PhyGenBench, text-to-video models are required to generate videos of different physical phenomena across settings which span a wide range of domains, such as mechanics, optics, thermodynamics and materials.
blocks.zh:
我们根据PhyGen Bench(Meng等,2025年)基准来评估文本条件生成。
在"PhyGen Bench"中,需要文本到视频模型来生成跨设置的不同物理现象的视频,这些视频跨越了广泛的领域,如力学,光学,热力学和材料等.

blocks.en: Models are evaluated on their ability to accurately visualise the features which uniquely determine the physical phenomena, such as showing the correct flame color of copper burning, or correctly reasoning about the buoyancy of objects of different densities.
blocks.zh: 模型被评价其准确可视化确定物理现象的独特特征的能力,例如显示铜燃烧的正确火焰颜色,或正确推理不同密度物体的浮力.

blocks.en: 4.3. Controllability
blocks.zh: 4.3. 可控性

blocks.en:
The right panel of Figure 9 shows that the keyframes are also trivially controllable via user-specified edits.
In this example, two keyframes are generated of a flower bud, and the flower once blossomed using Gemini 3.1 Flash Image ( DeepMind, 2026a ) .
These are used to produce a video showing the full timelapse of the bud opening.
We then use the same image model to simply update the final image, changing the color of the inner petals to be white and orange.
Regenerating the video with these keyframes correctly updates the video dynamics.
blocks.zh:
图9的右面板显示,通过用户指定的编辑,键框也是微不足道的可控.
在这个例子中,花蕾产生出两个键框,花朵曾用双子座3.1闪光影像开花(DeepMind,2026a. 。 。 。 。
这些用来制作一个视频,显示芽开的全时间隔.
然后我们用同一种图像模型来简单地更新最终的图像,将内花瓣的颜色改为白色和橙色.
用这些键框再生视频,正确更新了视频动态.

blocks.en: 4.4. Keyframe Conditioning
blocks.zh: 4.4. 关键框架

blocks.en:
We next verify that conditioning on keyframes is what drives the improvement, independently of how well the keyframes are chosen.
In this experiment, we take N N evenly-spaced keyframes from ground-truth videos in the Physics-IQ Verified dataset.
We then condition Wan2.2-5B with one trial on these ground-truth keyframes in the central perspective and score the resulting videos.
Our results show that this conditioning structure consistently improves Physics-IQ Verified score as the number of keyframes increases.
Results are shown in the left panel of Figure 9 .
blocks.zh:
接下来我们核实,对关键框架的调节是推动改进的因素,而不管关键框架的选择如何良好。
在这个实验中,我们从物理-IQ验证数据集中的地真视频中取取N平相相键框.
然后,我们给Wan2.2-5B做一个条件,从中央角度对这些地面真相关键框架进行一次试验,并评分所产生的视频。
我们的结果显示,这种调节结构随着键框数量的增加,不断改善物理-IQ验证分数.
图9左面板显示结果。

blocks.en:
While increasing the number of keyframes initially linearly improves the Physics-IQ Verified score, it plateaus where a high number of keyframes are used, indicating that once the motion is specified by the supplied keyframes, adding information in the form of more keyframes does not improve generation.
We also note that in this experiment the keyframes are selected to be evenly-spaced, and are therefore naive in their placement.
We propose to use a small number of keyframes at carefully placed locations within a given video.
blocks.zh:
虽然增加键框的数量最初线性地改进了物理-IQ验证分数,但它却在使用大量键框的地方稳定了下来,表明一旦提供键框指定了运动,以更键框的形式添加信息并不能改善生成.
我们还注意到,在这项试验中,关键框架被选定为分布均匀,因此在放置方面是天真的。
我们提议在某一段录像中精心放置的地点使用少量关键框。

blocks.en: Figure 9. Left: Conditioning Wan2.2-5B on N N equally spaced ground truth keyframes, for N N between 1 and 6, raises the Physics-IQ Verified score from 27.7 to 67.4. Right: Editing the final keyframe with the same image edit model used in our pipeline yields a new video, here with the inner petals recoloured.
blocks.zh: 图 9. "左":在N N等空地地面真理键框上为Wan2.2-5B作条件,对于N N介于1至6之间,将物理-IQ验证分从27.7分提高到67.4分. 对: 用我们输油管所用的图像编辑模型 来编辑最后的键盘 产生新的视频 里面的花瓣重排

blocks.en: 4.5. Ablations

We conduct a thorough ablation of all components of our method on the central perspective of Physics-IQ Verified.
We ablate the agentic loop, instead prompting the language model once to provide a chain of image edit instructions which are passed directly to the image model.
This reveals that our agentic pipeline is essential due to its ability to review and correct errors made by the image edit model, or to refine its image edits.
We also replace the language and image editing models with open-weight variants, using Qwen3-VL Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) for planning and the recently released Qwen-Image-2.1 ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) for image editing.
This variant scores 40.2, 15.8 points below the full method, which shows that closed-source models are presently still needed for their ability to edit an image with the precision required to construct an accurate video.
blocks.zh:
我们在物理-IQ验证的中央角度上 彻底废除了我们方法的所有组成部分
我们放弃了代理循环,而是促使语言模型一次提供一系列图像编辑指令,这些指令直接传递给图像模型。
这揭示出,我们的代理管道至关重要,因为它能够审查和纠正图像编辑模型所出错误,或完善其图像编辑。
我们还将语言和图像编辑模型取而代之为开放量级变体,使用Qune3-VL Instruct(Bai等,2025年)进行规划,并使用最近发布的Qune-Image-2.1(Qune Team,2026年)进行图像编辑.
这个变体的分数低于全方法的40.2分,15.8分,这表明目前仍然需要闭源模型才能准确编辑一个图像来构建准确的视频.

blocks.en:
We additionally ablate several conditioning features of our method.
We ablate any keyframes provided which do not sit at 0s or 5s, and show that intermediate keyframes are essential for producing accurate generations.
We ablate the conditioning to be sparse between identical keyframes, so that when two keyframes are provided which are identical, we do not automatically repeat this identical keyframe every second between the two keyframes, nor hold the video still once the plan declares the scene at rest, both as described in Section 3.1.2 .
This demonstrates our earlier note, that the video model often invents spurious motion betwen two identical keyframes.
We ablate the benchmark caption, instead providing the original caption which was provided with the input frame, which shows that densely prompting the motion in a scene also supports more accurate video generation.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们降低了我们方法的几个条件特征。
我们放弃所提供的0分或5分之外的任何键框,并表明中间键框对产生准确的代数至关重要。
我们放弃了相同的键框之间的空隙条件,这样,当提供了两个相同的键框时,我们不会在两个键框之间每秒自动重复一个相同的键框,也不会像第3.1.2节所描述的那样,一旦计划宣布场景处于休止状态,视频就仍然被保留。
这证明了我们早先的笔记,即视频模型经常发明出假动作贝文两个相同的键框.
我们放弃基准标题,而是提供原始标题,提供输入框,这表明在某一场景中密集地激发运动也支持更准确的视频生成。

blocks.en: Finally, we ablate color correction, showing that the use of keyframes does lead to color varying throughout a video, but that this can be rectified with a simple affine transformation of the frame colors.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们降低颜色校正,表明使用键框确实会导致整个视频中颜色的改变,但可以通过对帧颜色的简单的外缘转换来纠正.

blocks.en: 5. Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 限制

blocks.en:
Our proposed approach incurs a minor additional cost to the process of generation.
On average for Physics-IQ Verified, the median time taken to plan one scene was 62 seconds.
However, we highlight here that this is a minor cost compared to the time required to generate a video, which is around 32 minutes for Wan2.2-14B.
We additionally note that scaffolding Wan2.2-5B, which requires just 4 minutes per generation, with our method outperforms the 14B model, leading to an effective acceleration of accurate generation.
blocks.zh:
我们提议的办法给产生过程带来轻微的额外费用。
对于物理-IQ验证器来说,平均计划一个场景所需的中位时间为62秒.
然而,我们在此强调,与制作视频所需的时间相比,这是一个很小的费用,Wan2.2-14B大约为32分钟。
我们还注意到,脚手架的Wan2.2-5B,每代只需要4分钟,我们的方法就超过了14B模型,导致精确生成的有效加速.

blocks.en:
Although our method does resolve almost all physical plausibility problems in our test sets, there remain some instances where the language model fails to reason correctly about the physics of a scene, leading to an incorrect generation.
For example, in one scene a stack of blocks was reasoned incorrectly to be stable, whereas in fact the blocks were visibly unbalanced. This led to the generation of incorrect keyframes, and ultimately an implausible video.
We expect that the use of a stronger language model would further improve results.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的方法确实解决了我们测试集中几乎所有的物理可信度问题,但仍然存在一些语言模型无法正确解释一个场景的物理问题,导致一个错误的一代.
例如,在一个场景中,一堆区块被错误地认为是稳定的,而事实上这些区块显然是不平衡的。 这导致了不正确的键框的产生,最终是一部不可信的视频.
我们期望,使用更强有力的语言模式会进一步改善成果。

blocks.en:
Finally, while our method can set moments in a video, it cannot currently determine intermediate motion.
This can lead to remaining physical implausibilities where the model inserts incorrect motion.
We observe this most strongly in scenes with balls rolling, where a ball follows a trajectory which is not straight between keyframes, violating Newton’s First Law of motion.
blocks.zh:
最后,虽然我们的方法可以在视频中设定瞬间,但目前无法决定中间运动.
这会导致在模型插入不正确的运动时仍然存在物理上的不可信.
在球滚滚的场景中,我们最强烈地观察到这一点,一个球沿着一个不直接在键框之间的轨迹走,这违反了牛顿的第一运动定律。

blocks.en: 6. Conclusions and Discussion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论和讨论

blocks.en:
In conclusion, we proposed K2V, a novel approach for video generation which enforces adherence to set keyframes which are generated with a custom language model-backed keyframe module.
We proposed our method to redistribute the physical generation task required for accurate video generation from within video diffusion onto a language model, which has the ability to reason in text and to plan how a scene will evolve physically.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们提议采用K2V,这是一种新颖的视频生成方法,它强制遵守用自定义语言模型支持的键框模块生成的设定键框。
我们提出了我们的方法,从视频传播内部将准确生成视频所需的物理生成任务重新分配到语言模型上,语言模型有能力在文本中进行推理,并计划一个场景如何在物理上演化.

blocks.en:
Through our experiments we show that our approach is significantly more successful at generating videos which are physically plausible than any existing video generators.
On the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark we demonstrate state-of-the-art results by a significant margin.
Our approach scaffolding Wan2.2-14B outperforms Wan in its vanilla state by 22.8 points; and outperforms the existing state of the art by 12.3 points.
On PhyGenBench our method outperforms all comparable approaches in all physical categories tested.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验表明,我们的做法在制作视频方面比任何现有的视频生成器都成功得多。
在物理-IQ验证基准上,我们以相当的幅度展示了最新的结果。
我们的脚手架比Wan2.2-14B要好 其香草状态的Wan以22.8分;而表现则以12.3分超过现有状态.
在PhyGen Bench上,我们的方法在所有物理类别中都超过了所有可比方法。

blocks.zh: 7. 大赦国际的披露

blocks.en:
In this work, we used generative AI tools for implementing our approach in code and for providing feedback on research methodology.
We additionally used generative AI tools for suggesting experimental parameters and proposing related work.
We have reviewed all AI-assisted work, and take responsibility for the final content of this work.

在这项工作中,我们使用基因化的AI工具,在守则中执行我们的方法,并提供关于研究方法的反馈。
我们额外使用基因AI工具来建议实验参数并提议相关工作.

blocks.en: Ethics and Privacy Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守和隐私声明

blocks.en:
The rapid proliferation of generative video models has had widespread effects.
These include significant beneficial progress in fields such as computer graphics, robotics, and physical intelligence.
However, some effects have been negative, such as the distribution of content intended to deceive viewers.
Research which intends to improve the physical plausibility of generated content could make detection of generated content more difficult;
and developments in this field should be balanced with work to facilitate detection and watermarking of generated content.
However, presently we feel that the benefits of this research mean that improving physical plausibility is a justified objective.
blocks.zh:
基因视频模型的迅速扩散产生了广泛的影响.
其中包括计算机图形、机器人和物理智能等领域取得的重大有益进展。
然而,有些效果是负面的,如发布内容意图欺骗观众.
旨在改进所生成内容的物理可信性的研究可能使检测所生成内容更加困难;
这一领域的发展应与促进检测和标出所生成内容的工作相平衡。
然而,我们目前认为,这一研究的好处意味着提高物理可信度是一个正当的目标。

We show further results in Figure 10 , and further comparisons on Physics-IQ Verified against unmodified Wan2.2-14B and Cosmos3-Super in Figure 11 , continuing Figure 8 of the main paper. Every method is conditioned on the same input.
These highlight that our approach works in a diverse range of settings, including those requiring complex reasoning such as the Tyndall effect, the dispersion of light by a soap film, the colour of a magnesium flame and the spread of combustion.
All of this is facilitated through reasoning with a language model, and the successful integration of that model with a video model.

blocks.en: Your job is to build a **stack of keyframes**: pictures of this scene at fixed times, which together say what happens over those 5.00 seconds. The stack already holds the handover frame at 0.00s.
blocks.zh: 你的工作是建造一盘键盘 固定时间拍下这个场景的图片 上面都说出了这5.00秒后发生了什么 堆栈已经将移交框架维持在0.00.

blocks.en: You work through tools, and you can see what you make. Use that: look at the photograph before you commit it.
blocks.zh: 你通过工具工作, 你可以看到你制造的东西。 用这个: 在你拍之前看看照片。

blocks.en: ## What you are working with
blocks.zh: {\fn华文仿宋\fs16\1cHD1D1D1} 你的工作内容

blocks.en: The **stack** is the keyframes you have committed. Every photograph you render is made by editing the picture on top of the stack, so the arrangement one moment settles into is the arrangement the next moment starts from.
blocks.zh: 你所承诺的关键框架是**stack**。 你所制作的每一张照片都是通过编辑堆叠上方的相片来制作的,所以一个时刻的安排就是下一个时刻开始的安排.

blocks.en: ## Working out what happens
blocks.zh: {\fn华文仿宋\fs16\1cHD1D1D1} 想想会发生什么

blocks.en: - Reason physically, from what the frame actually shows: the objects present, their sizes and likely masses, what is in contact with what, what is already in motion and in which direction.
blocks.zh: - 物理上的理由,从框架实际显示的内容来看: 存在的物体,它们的大小和可能的质量,什么与什么有联系,什么已经在运动,什么方向上.

blocks.en: - Reason about where things end up.
blocks.zh: - 关于事情结局的原因

blocks.en: - If an interaction seems likely but will not in fact occur, do not depict it.
blocks.zh: - 说吧 如果某种互动看来可能但实际上不会发生,就不要描绘它。

blocks.en: - Do not invent objects, cuts or camera movement unless the description says so.
blocks.zh: - 说吧 不要发明物体,切口或相机运动,除非描述是这样说的.

blocks.en: ## Choosing the keyframes to add to the stack
blocks.zh: {\fn华文仿宋\fs16\1cHD1D1D1} 选择要添加到堆栈的密钥框

blocks.en: A keyframe is a moment worth pinning: a boundary between distinct phases of motion. Something arrives somewhere and the situation changes qualitatively — an object lands, stops, breaks contact, reverses, tips past balance, or reaches a configuration it then holds.
blocks.zh: 一个关键框架是一个值得注意的时刻:是运动不同阶段之间的界限。 某物到达某地,情况发生了质的变化——一个物体着陆,停止,断接,倒转,提示过平衡,或者达到它当时的配置.

blocks.en: Choose them sparsely. Most scenes need one or two. Use three or four only when the span genuinely contains that many distinct phases. Do not narrate the mechanism: where several things happen in quick succession as part of one continuous event, that is one keyframe, the state the event leaves behind.
blocks.zh: 选择他们很少。 大部分场景需要一两个. 只有在跨度真正包含许多不同阶段时才使用三到四个阶段。 切勿描述机制: 在一个连续事件中, 即一个关键框架中, 有几件事会迅速连续发生, 事件会留下状态 。

blocks.en: **Always include a keyframe at 5.00s**, even if this moment does not represent the boundary of a distinct phase.
blocks.zh: ** 始终包括5.00s**的键框,即使这一时刻并不代表一个不同相的边界。

blocks.en: ## Rendering and committing
blocks.zh: {\fn华文仿宋\fs16\1cHD1D1D1} 编造和实施

blocks.en: `render_edit` takes a text instruction and the keyframe at the top of the stack, and asks an image model to edit the keyframe according to the instruction. You should specify the edit in terms of what should and should not change to accomplish the edit. You should consider that your instruction should direct the edit relative to the top keyframe, not the handover frame unless the top keyframe is not the handover frame and no renders have already been added to the stack.
blocks.zh: `rest_edit'在堆栈顶端取出文本指示和键框,并要求图像模型根据指示来编辑键框. 您应该指定编辑内容, 以完成编辑工作 。 您应当考虑您的指示应该引导编辑相对于顶端密钥框架, 而不是移交框架, 除非顶端密钥框架不是移交框架, 并且堆栈中还没有添加任何密钥 。

blocks.en: Renders are the one expensive thing you do, and the budget is small: **8 of them for this scene**, and 24 turns in total. Every tool result ends with what is left of both.
blocks.zh: 铸币局是你最贵的,而预算是很小的:**8份是这个场景**,总共24个转. 每个工具结果都以两者的剩余部分为结尾。

blocks.en: **Every render must be evaluated before you can do anything else.** As soon as one comes back, `evaluate_render` is the only tool available to you: say what the picture actually shows, item by item. Count what is countable. Only once you have answered can you render again, or add it to the stack.
blocks.zh: ** 在你能够做其他事情之前,必须评估每项构成。 ** 一旦有人回来,`评价-投降'是唯一可供你使用的工具:逐项说出图片实际显示的内容。 数数可数. 只有回答一次,你才能再次变形,或者把它添加到堆栈中。

blocks.en: **Look at what came back, and anticipate that it might be wrong.** It may quietly change things it was not asked about — the most common failures are objects appearing or disappearing, object counts changing, an object ending up in a different place or a different orientation from the one you drew. Judge it item by item:
blocks.zh: ** 看看回来的是什么,并预计它可能是错误的。 ** 它可能会悄悄地改变它没有被问到的东西——最常见的失败是物体出现或消失,物体计数变化,一个物体结束在一个不同的地方,或者一个与你画的那个不同的方向. 按项目判断:

blocks.en: - Is everything you expect present in the photograph, and nothing else?
blocks.zh: - 说吧 照片上所有你期望的东西都存在吗?

blocks.en: - Is each thing that moved where you expected it, at the orientation described?
blocks.zh: - 说吧 每一件事情 移动到你预期的地方, 在描述的方向?

blocks.en: - Has anything changed that you did not expect?
blocks.zh: - 有什么你没想到的变化吗?

blocks.en: Nothing checks this after you. Whatever you push is what is accepted as a keyframe, and a keyframe that says something untrue about the scene is worse than one you spent another render getting right.
blocks.zh: 在你之后,没有什么能证实这一点。 不管你推什么 被接受为关键框架 和关键框架 说一些不真实的场景 比一个你花 另一个使得到正确。

blocks.en: If it does not match, you have three options to correct it. You can adjust the edit instruction given to `render_edit` to more strictly enforce the edit, or you can simply run the render again, since the rendering model is stochastic.
blocks.zh: 如果它不匹配,你有三种选择来纠正它. 您可以调整给“ 交付_ edit” 的编辑指令, 以便更严格地执行编辑, 或者您可以简单地再次运行渲染, 因为渲染模型是有花样的 。

blocks.en: You have a numbered list of **images**. Image 0 is the handover frame; every render you make is added to it as image 1, 2, and so on, and they all stay available for the rest of the run.
blocks.zh: 你有一个编号列表 ** 图像 **。 图像0是交接框架;你所做的每一个渲染被添加到其中作为图像1,2等,它们都保留在运行的剩余时间.

blocks.en: `add_keyframe` puts one of those images on the stack at a time. It uses the most recent image unless you name another, and it uses nothing up:
blocks.zh: `add_keyframe'一次将其中一个图像放入堆放地上。 它使用最新的图像,除非你给另一个命名,它没有使用任何内容:

blocks.en: - If a second attempt comes back worse than the first, add the earlier one by its number rather than paying for a third. `view_image` shows you one again if it has scrolled out of sight.
blocks.zh: - 说吧 如果第二次尝试比第一次更糟糕,则按其数目加上先前的一次,而不是支付第三次。 `视图-图像'如果卷出视线,就再给你看一张。

blocks.en: - If nothing changes between one moment and a later one, add the _same_ image at both times rather than rendering the same picture twice. It costs no render and cannot introduce a difference nobody asked for.
blocks.zh: - 说吧 如果在一瞬间和后一瞬间之间没有变化,请在两次中添加_same_图像,而不是两次渲染出同一张相片. 它不花任何代价,也不能造成任何变化。

blocks.en: - If nothing changes at all, add image 0 — the handover frame — at the end of the clip.
blocks.zh: - 说吧 如果完全没有变化,则在剪辑后方添加图像0——交接框架.

blocks.en: Choosing between pictures you already have costs nothing. Making another costs a render.
blocks.zh: 在相片中选择你已经没有代价了 做另一个代价 一个渲染。

blocks.en: ## Finishing
blocks.zh: □ 结束

blocks.en: Call `finish` with one paragraph of plain description of the action in the whole 5.00 seconds. The description you give should expand on the content contained in the scene description. It should contain all of the information in the original description, with a detailed account of what happens in the 5.00 seconds after the handover frame, and no more. Content should only be removed if it refers to something that occurs before the handover frame, and would therefore not be relevant for the 5.00 seconds after it.
blocks.zh: 在5.00分整秒内用一段简单描述行动来称呼 " 完成 " 。 您的描述应该扩展到场景描述中包含的内容. 它应该包含原始描述中的所有信息,详细叙述移交框架后5.00秒内发生的情况,不再出现. 内容只有在提到移交框架之前发生的事情时才应去除,因此与移交框架之后的5.00秒无关.
